name: calzone
title: Calzone
description: A takeaway pizzeria theme printed like its own box: the whole page sits inside the lid's one fat border in a single basil-green ink on white board, and the menu is the flap's order panel — an empty printed tick square before every dish, prices ranged right, section names in underscored oblique capitals, ending in the fluted kraft edge of the cardboard.

tokens.--font-display: the box print, in heavy slanted capitals: site title, menu links, page and panel titles, headings, section names, prices, table heads, hours labels, the order button, post titles in the list, dates, tags
tokens.--font-body: body text, dish names and descriptions, and the values on the hours card
tokens.--font-mono: inline code and code blocks in page text
tokens.--tracking-caps: letter spacing of the slanted capitals
tokens.--color-bg: the board: page background (white by day, deep basil green at night)
tokens.--color-text: all text — the one ink — and the ground of selected text
tokens.--color-muted: secondary text: dish descriptions, dates, quotations, page numbers, the footer
tokens.--color-accent: everything printed that is not a letter: the lid's fat border, tick squares and ticks, the rules, the order button's outline, focus rings — and links
tokens.--color-tint: a pale screen of the ink: code backgrounds, and the order button on hover
tokens.--color-kraft: the pale cardboard fill of the cut edge at the foot of the order panel
tokens.--color-flute: the darker cardboard lines of that edge: its two liners and the wave of flutes between them
tokens.--measure: maximum width of the text column on pages, posts and the post list
tokens.--measure-lid: maximum width of the lid, the bordered frame that holds the page
tokens.--measure-flap: maximum width of the order panel on the menu page, on a dish's own page and on the not-found page
tokens.--rule-lid: weight of the lid's fat border on a wide screen (it thins on a phone)
tokens.--rule: weight of the medium rules: under the masthead and the panel title, above the footer, the hours card and the post list, the underscore of section names, the bar beside a quotation, the order button's outline, focus rings
tokens.--keyline: weight of the thin printed lines: tick squares, the order panel's outline, the liners of the cut edge, table heads, the dashed divider
tokens.--radius-lid: corner rounding of the lid's border; the order button takes a little under half of it
tokens.--radius: the small corner rounding of tick squares, the order panel, code and images
tokens.--tick: side of the tick square before a dish; the menu links use a smaller one and a dish's own page a larger one
tokens.--flute: half the height of the corrugation at the foot of the order panel; one wave is four times as long
tokens.--space-1: hairline gap: between a dish and its description, between an hours label and its value
tokens.--space-2: small gap: above and below each dish line and each hours row, under the panel title
tokens.--space-3: gap between paragraphs, around section names on the panel, and inside the panel's top edge
tokens.--space-4: gap between blocks, and above page titles
tokens.--space-5: large gap: above the footer, and between the home page's text and its order panel
